name: configuration-management-design
description: Design configuration management for a service: key catalog + types + defaults + validation, precedence order (flags > env > file > defaults), source selection (env var / file / remote config / feature flag service), secrets separation (12-factor + vault / KMS), hot-reload vs restart-required, schema validation at boundary, config drift detection, feature flags vs business config vs infra config. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
